articles.title: Bombay HC Quashes Reassessment Notice Under Section 148 for Mere Change of Opinion
articles.summary: The Bombay High Court has set aside a tax reassessment notice issued under Section 148 of the Income Tax Act, ruling that it was based on a mere change of opinion and not on any failure to disclose material facts. The court emphasized that reassessment proceedings beyond four years are invalid if there is complete disclosure by the taxpayer. This decision impacts tax reassessment procedures and reinforces legal safeguards for taxpayers against arbitrary tax demands.

The proposed framework will cover research and development facilities, semiconductor-grade materials, test and characterisation facilities, and the manufacture and assembly of semiconductor equipment, the people said.

articles.title: India's Russian crude imports hit record for second straight month
articles.summary: India's Russian crude oil imports reached a record in July, increasing by 2.1 percent. This surge was primarily fueled by smaller import terminals across the country. Larger terminals like Jamnagar saw stable volumes, while Paradip experienced a decline. India remains a significant buyer of Russian fossil fuels, second only to China. This trend highlights India's continued reliance on discounted Russian energy supplies.

This trend highlights India's continued reliance on discounted Russian energy supplies.
articles.context_summary: India’s Russian crude purchases surged to a record in July, with imports crossing half of the country’s total crude intake. The rise came despite tighter Western sanctions and a narrowing discount for Russian oil, with higher receipts at smaller Indian terminals offsetting weaker volumes at major ports.

articles.title: ETtech Explainer: Meta's stop-start strategy for its open source AI models
articles.summary: Meta has developed Glimmer, a smaller AI model with 30 billion parameters, designed to run on personal devices like Macs or PCs with a single graphics card. This model targets agentic tasks and aims to meet demand for AI systems that operate locally on user devices. The development highlights trends in decentralized AI and could impact discussions around India's AI governance, data localization, and digital sovereignty policies.
